labs.name: Cambridge Resilient Autonomous Learning Lab
labs.description: Official Cambridge CST profile for Rika Antonova states she leads the Cambridge Resilient Autonomous Learning (CamRAL) Lab and links camral.github.io.
labs.research_summary: Official themes: Machine Learning and Artificial Intelligence; Mobile Systems, Robotics and Automation. Official teaching includes Reinforcement Learning.

labs.name: Cambridge Machine Learning Systems Lab
labs.description: Official Nic Lane faculty page directs readers to the lab website http://mlsys.cst.cam.ac.uk/ for complete information.
labs.research_summary: Official teaching includes Deep Neural Networks, Federated Learning, and Principles of Machine Learning Systems. Official themes include Machine Learning and Artificial Intelligence.

labs.name: Affective Intelligence and Robotics Lab
labs.description: Official Hatice Gunes CST profile lists her as Director of AFAR Lab and links Affective Intelligence and Robotics (AFAR) Lab.
labs.research_summary: Official biography: multimodal, social, and affective intelligence for AI systems, particularly embodied agents and robots, combining machine learning, affective computing, and social signal processing.

labs.name: Prorok Lab
labs.description: Official Amanda Prorok CST profile describes the Prorok Lab as working on multi-agent systems and algorithmic coordination of robot collectives.
labs.research_summary: Official page: multi-agent systems, differentiable communication, multi-robot perception and control, robotic fleet coordination.
